additional_concerns: The source imposes continuing responsibility; it does not supply a complete test for effective retention or discharge through supervision. Governance, practical authority and conduct are possible evidence, not source-established necessary or sufficient conditions.

Retained accountability, supervisory conduct and operational outcomes must remain distinct. Neither an operational failure nor successful outsourcing alone determines whether accountability was retained.

Paragraph 14 places the express request condition on demonstration; confirmation is separately stated. Footnote 5 may elaborate that conditioned demonstration or support an independently unqualified expectation. Neither reading makes absence of an SFC request proof of retained accountability or substantive compliance.
Paragraph 15 concerns requested audit or verification; paragraph 16 concerns a requested satisfactory legal opinion supporting an application. Neither procurement duty supplies a retention test.

The register-maintenance provisions and the intermediary issuance provision preserve separate actor and activity scopes. They do not establish that every Product Provider must personally perform outsourced tasks or reserve every operational decision.
